scripts.text:
DECLARE @MaxID bigint
SELECT @MaxID= ISNULL( max (LogId), 0) +1 FROM [dbo].[TBL_LOG_FMForecast]

INSERT INTO.[dbo].[TBL_LOG_FMForecast]

([LogId], [NameOfPackage],[StartOfExecution],[EndOfExecution],[ErrorMessage],[Status])

VALUES
(
@MaxID, @0,getdate(),NULL,NULL,NULL
)
SELECT @MaxID as LogId

SELECT CONVERT(varchar, min([TheDate]),23) FROM [SA4NAV4_EDW_RCSAS].[dbo].[EDW Time] 
WHERE [MarsYear]=  ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUBSTRING([MarsPeriod],2,2) = '13' 
 THEN [MarsYear] - 2 ELSE [MarsYear] - 3 END 
FROM [SA4NAV4_EDW_RCSAS].[dbo].[EDW Time] WHERE CONVERT( date, GETDATE())=[DateName]
) 
AND [MarsPeriod]= ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUBSTRING([MarsPeriod],2,2) = '13' THEN 'P01' 
ELSE CASE WHEN CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING([MarsPeriod],2,2)) + 1 < 10 THEN 'P0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(2), CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING([MarsPeriod],2,2)) + 1)
  ELSE 'P'+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(2), CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING([MarsPeriod],2,2)) + 1) END  END 
FROM [SA4NAV4_EDW_RCSAS].[dbo].[EDW Time] WHERE CONVERT( date, GETDATE())=[DateName]
)

Truncate table dbo.[EDW Sales Fact RCSAS]

Truncate table dbo.[EDW Sales Fact RNI]

Truncate table dbo.[EDW Production Fact RCSAS]

Truncate table dbo.[EDW Production Fact RNI]

Truncate table dbo.[EDW Product RCSAS]

Truncate table dbo.[EDW Product RNI]

UPDATE  dbo.[TBL_LOG_FMForecast]
 SET EndOfExecution  = GETDATE(), Status = 'C'
WHERE LogId =@LogId
